template: raes-library-template
version: 1
id: segmented-network-scenario
surface: scenario
requirement_refs:
- AUT-806
source_refs:
- docs/explain/sdl/sections.md
- docs/explain/sdl/validation.md
summary: Two-segment network template with switches, linked hosts, fixed addresses,
  access rules, and a service feature.
validation:
- command: uv run --project implementations/python --frozen python tools/check_example_library.py
  expected: Exits 0 with no output. The gate reads this file with the sdl-yaml/v1
    loader, which rejects duplicate keys and merge keys. It parses the body with the
    SDL parser and semantic validator and fails on any error or advisory.
- command: uv run --project implementations/python --frozen raes semantic validate
    my-scenario.sdl.yaml
  expected: 'With the body saved as my-scenario.sdl.yaml, prints "validate: success"
    and exits 0. This command does not report semantic-validator advisories.'
body:
  name: library-segmented-network-template
  description: Two network segments with one host each, fixed addresses, and access
    rules that admit only HTTPS from the user segment to the server segment.
  nodes:
    user-net:
      type: switch
    server-net:
      type: switch
    workstation:
      type: compute
      resources:
        ram: 2 GiB
        cpu: 1
    web:
      type: compute
      resources:
        ram: 1 GiB
        cpu: 1
      features:
      - web-server
      services:
      - port: 443
        protocol: tcp
        name: https
  features:
    web-server:
      type: Service
      source:
        name: nginx-1.24
        version: '*'
  infrastructure:
    user-net:
      count: 1
      properties:
        cidr: 10.20.1.0/24
        gateway: 10.20.1.1
        internal: true
    server-net:
      count: 1
      properties:
        cidr: 10.20.2.0/24
        gateway: 10.20.2.1
        internal: true
      acls:
      - name: allow-user-https
        direction: in
        from_net: user-net
        protocol: tcp
        ports:
        - 443
        action: allow
      - name: deny-user-other
        direction: in
        from_net: user-net
        action: deny
    workstation:
      count: 1
      links:
      - user-net
      properties:
      - user-net: 10.20.1.10
    web:
      count: 1
      links:
      - server-net
      properties:
      - server-net: 10.20.2.10
name: changed
